thread:
alex: FYI we had a weird churn loop on dedicated-eu last night. one tenant fired a bunch of short jobs and the pool kept adding then removing nodes.
jean: saw that. looked like allocator + scaler disagreement: allocator granted warmup tokens, scaler interpreted sustained pressure and launched nodes, then pressure dropped and nodes torn down.
maria: exact timeline: token grant spike at 02:12, node add at 02:13, node remove at 02:15. warmup cost wasted.
tim: proposal: introduce a transient burst buffer (short-lived, non-node-backed credits) to absorb sub-2m bursts. only convert to node allocations after N consecutive windows.
sophia: agree. name and parameters sketch:

```
transient_buffer:
  window: 30s
  max_credits: 10p
  promote_after: 4   # promote to node allocate after 4 windows
  decay_per_window: 0.25
  per_tenant_cap: 4p
```

alex: couple notes: 1) buffer must be accounted for in fairness calc so big tenants don't monopolize; 2) expose buffer state in metrics.
jean: do we charge tenants for buffer usage? if not, can be gamed. maybe small burn-rate billing or use pre-funded burst credits.
maria: practical: use weighted allocation by recent steady usage + hard per-tenant cap. billing: mark buffer usage as "metered_burst" so product can decide billing later.
tim: ops: add an alert when overall buffer utilization > 60% for >5m AND scale decisions are suppressed. we need visibility if buffer masks true capacity shortages.
sophia: also add a dry-run mode in autoscaler that emits "would_scale" traces when buffer is absorbing pressure. helps oncall understand tradeoffs.
ops-bot: running canary for transient-buffer on 1821003600 with 3% of traffic.
alex: nit: when promoting to nodes, prefer mixed-instance small profiles first to reduce cost and startup time.
maria: make sure to re-run sim harness against last 45 days of traces. key tuning knobs: promote_after and decay_per_window.
jean: next steps: implement buffer admission + metrics (maria), add autoscaler dry-run traces and alert (tim), add billing tag and sim runs (sophia). I'll put together rollout checklist and canary gating criteria.
alex: thanks. i'll open a tiny RFC PR with the DSL and include sample Grafana panels for buffer metrics. :thumbsup:
